name: @kayushkin/chat-core
description: Framework-light data layer for dash's chat surface: in-memory store, IndexedDB cache, SSE sync engine, and a non-destructive turn reducer. Renders from memory; the network only reconciles.
author: Slava Kayushkin <slava@kayushkin.com>

scripts.//check: The assertion the nightly repo-node-guard runs. `test` only, deliberately: tsconfig.json has include:[src] and excludes test/, and dist/ + *.tsbuildinfo are gitignored, so in a clean clone `build` (tsc -b) already type-checks exactly the files `typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) would. Adding typecheck here would re-run the build stage's own check and still not reach the test tree.
